step1_cash_parked_arm.avg_true_cash_share_note: By construction this arm parks all idle dollars in SPY at every snapshot, so uninvested raw cash averages ~0% across the window (any residual is the shortfall_total below, a running total across events, not a standing balance).
step1_cash_parked_arm.interpretation_note: final_value ($192679.64) treats every funding shortfall (times SPY fell in value between being parked and being needed back for a real trade) as costlessly covered -- an optimistic assumption. Since shortfall_total ($12734.74) is added back in full, the apparent $12734.73 gain over the unmodified control (192679.64 - 179944.91) is ENTIRELY the shortfall add-back, not a genuine SPY-parking gain: 12734.74 of a 12734.73 delta. final_value_conservative_no_shortfall_addback ($179944.91) does not backfill shortfalls and lands within a few cents of the control (179944.91), i.e. statistically indistinguishable from it. Both the optimistic and conservative readings land WELL BELOW buy-and-hold (,584.28), so the qualitative conclusion (idle cash parking does not close the gap to buy-and-hold) does not depend on resolving which reading is correct.
